en: The postcard consists of two main sides. The front (photo) side depicts a group of people posing in front of a building entrance: several men in uniforms/coats, a woman in dark clothing with flowers, a person on a ladder with a bucket, and a woman in a white apron beside a cart with belongings. The scene looks staged, possibly commemorative or celebratory, possibly marking an arrival or move-in. The reverse side (writing side) is filled with handwritten German text. There is a stamp with 'MUSEUM IM SCHLOSS BAD PYRMONT' and bold printed and handwritten German text, including a clear mention of 'Einzug des Ehepaars Wulff im Haus Eichborn zu Pyrmont am 10. XII. 1917'.
